column1: # Each non-comment row has five tab-separated fields:
# Paths are repository-relative. `frontend` is `pass` or the exact expected
# unresolved state. `native` assigns every package to one host gate rather than
# silently omitting libraries or special link inputs. The `raylib` class has a
# dedicated headless shared-provider build/link/render gate. The `validation`
# field declares every package whose Draft tests or benchmarks run in native CI.
